This game used to be fun but now it seems like the game is designed to make sure killer mains have the worst experience and when they complain about it they're treated like dirt and verbally assaulted by the community.

Killer matches now feel like you lose the game in the first minute every time. In the time it takes you to find your first survivor to chase they have already found their generators to repair so 4 generators will have progress. If you are playing for this example skull merchant the survivor does not have to even enter a loop with you they can just pre - drop as many pallets as they want without needing to risk a 50/50 or a mind game. In the time it tales the killer to down this survivor one of 2 things will happen - 1: 3 Gens pop at once because the other 3 survivors didnt get off the gens - SOmeone blinds you with a flashlight and resets your progress. In both of these instances the killer has already lost. 

The main cause for this is the design of how many objectives each side needs, Killer needs 3 hooks per player times 4 so its 12 hooks vs 5 gens. In order for the killer to win they need 3 hooks per gen when chases last a generator each (At higher MMR) making the basic premise extremely survivor sided. Not to mention the extreme amount of safety and second chance perks that can either extend a chase or reset it all together. 
Dead hard - adds another hit needed to make you go down doubling chase time, Decisive strike - Resets chase time. 

Not to mention every supposedly "Overpowered" Killer perk can be avoided and denied value with no thought on the survivors part. Ruin? Just cleanse it because it always spawns in the most open spot on the map. Bamboozle? Just avoid windows. Pain res? Needs to hook you first and also has to be on a scourge hook which NEVER spawns close enough to where you down someone. Eruption? Needs a down to activate which the survivors are already body blocking and dead harding.

If the killer even manages to win the survivors will berate them with constant toxic messages just because they lost in a video game. If you need proof just look at my steam profile comments to see first hand how salty these survivors can get. 

If you plan on playing survivor, get this game the devs will make sure anything you ask for will be added by their JOKE of a balance team. If you're looking to play killer I hope you're a masochist who likes being degraded because that is the only type of person I can see enjoying this experience

I'm a new player who bought the game this week during the big fall discount. I heard a lot of bad things about the matchmaking but I was like surely not! I'm already used to shitty matchmaking thanks to playing a lot of moba. So I go que up as Trapper to start on doing the beginner quests to get some bloodpoints to level up the killers I actually want to play (Kaneki and Springtrap fyi) I was then shot 57 times.

I started my experience with playing survivor (I WANTED THOSE EXTRA BLOODPOINTS BADLY) But I got tired of getting destroyed by ranged killers and the random Blight or Nurse pretty quickly and as a mostly solo player I felt bad dragging my team down so after 3 days of having the game and 4 hours of total playtime I switched from survivor to killer.

Since steam doesn't allow me to attach pictures in my review here's what I, as a single green perk Trapper (I ain't wasting my money leveling that man up) playing my first killer match, was up against (I had to look up the levels on dbd wiki sigh):
Milestone 3 lvl 63 Sable with head on, last stand, iron will, dead hard + banquet flashlight, long life battery, high end sapphire lens
Empty Circle Feng Min with residual manifest, hyperfocus, unbreakable, prove thyself + utility flashlight, tir optic, battery
Milestone 3 lvl 64 Claudette with head on, dead hard, iron will, last stand + flashlight, long life battery, tir optic
Milestone 4 lvl 100 Claudette with iron will, dead hard, head on, flashbang + utility flashlight, heavy duty battery, long life battery

Anyway my first chase was great! I found someone working on the first gen I went to check on. I got a hit in bc she saw me coming too late, she went to loop shack which was next to us but I swung through the shack window and downed her. I was satisfied with that and expected that to be my one and only hook honestly... But what do you know they all came to throw themselves at me in basement. In fact, they were WAITING for me in basement lockers. Funnily enough they managed to miss the timing for their stupid ass head on and I got the hook. You can imagine how the rest of the 7 min game went. I only had 2 traps so I couldn't even lock down shack but I didn't need to as they were too desperate to mess with me and just kept coming back without even healing lol. I lowk thought I got put against bots without the game telling me they are bots (like mobas do for new players if you know) bc WHO does that? At least go heal. WHY ARE YOU STILL HERE???? But then I got hit with an ''ez'' in endgame chat. Like huh?? Easy for ME they must mean lmaooooo. I mean- Thanks for giving me my first 4k I guess? But now I'm too scared to play killer again bc what if I get matched with even better players since I got a 4k on THOSE guys? 

Also big thanks to all those beginner guides on yt bc imagine if I had to go up against that if I had no idea wtf this game was. Once again anxiety saves my ass. Patting my past self on the back rn bc you KNOW if I had no idea what perks were or to look away from flashlights etc those guys were gonna bully me 100% then act smug in endgame chat. I will not be having any of that- Get absolutely dunked on <3

Still I paid money for this and I got free time so might as well countinue playing. If any newer players are interested I'm down to que up as survivor together or to practice in customs. If worried about ping; I looked it up and it says I get put in Europe servers (mostly london or frankfurt) since Turkey doesn't have a dedicated server of it's own.

TLDR: Matchmaking is shit  and the learning curve is insane but hit me up if you wanna que up together
